data.completion_memo: Root cause: `.composer-input` had `overflow: hidden` (added to stop an over-tall textarea painting over the toolbar), which also clipped every absolutely-positioned popover anchored to controls inside it (attachment menu, subagents, task list, goal, context) at the field's top edge. Fix: wrapped the textarea in a new `.composer-text` grid row that owns the clip, and set `.composer-input` to `overflow: visible`. Popover anchoring is unchanged. Verified: `pnpm check` (tsc) clean; chat vitest 283/286 pass with the 3 failures pre-existing and environment-only (German number locale in cacheUsage; Windows `powershell` vs expected `bash` dialect in ToolCallCard/toolCallPresentation). Reproduced and confirmed the fix in headless Edge with the real styles.css/context.css: with the current CSS, a point just above the field resolves to `context-popover` (painted above the field); forcing `overflow: hidden` back on `.composer-input` makes the same point resolve to `composer-shell` (clipped). Temporary probe files removed.
data.description: The composer toolbar's anchored popovers (attachment menu, subagents, task list, goal, context usage) open upward with `bottom: calc(100% + 14px)` from controls inside `.composer-input`. That field had `overflow: hidden` to stop a textarea taller than its row from painting over the toolbar, which also clipped every popover at the field's top edge. Fix: scope the clipping to a new `.composer-text` row that wraps the textarea, and set `.composer-input` to `overflow: visible`, so the toolbar's popovers can open above the composer while the textarea is still clipped.
data.title: Fix composer control popovers clipped by the Chat input field
